title: Call-Chain-Aware LLM-Based Test Generation for Java Projects
abstract: arXiv:2604.22046v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for generating project-level unit tests. However, existing state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on execution-path information to guide prompt construction, which is often insufficient for complex software systems with rich inter-class dependencies, deep call chains, and intricate object initialization requirements. In this paper, we present CAT, a novel call-chain-aware LLM-based test generation approach that explicitly incorporates call-chain and dependency contexts into prompts through dedicated static analysis. To construct executable, semantically valid test contexts, CAT systematically models caller--callee relationships, object constructors, and third-party dependencies, and supports iterative test fixing when generation failures occur. We evaluate CAT on the widely used Defects4J benchmark and on four real-world GitHub projects released after the LLM

translated_title: 面向Java项目的调用链感知的基于大语言模型的测试生成
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2604.22046v2，公告类型：replace-cross）：大语言模型（LLMs）近来在生成项目级单元测试方面展现出强大潜力。然而，现有最先进的方法主要依赖执行路径信息来指导提示词的构建，这对于具有丰富类间依赖、深层调用链和复杂对象初始化需求的复杂软件系统而言往往是不够的。在本文中，我们提出了CAT，一种新颖的调用链感知的基于大语言模型的测试生成方法，它通过专门的静态分析将调用链和依赖上下文显式地融入提示词中。为了构建可执行的、语义上有效的测试上下文，CAT系统地建模了调用者—被调用者关系、对象构造函数和第三方依赖，并在生成失败时支持迭代式测试修复。我们在广泛使用的Defects4J基准数据集以及四个在LLM发布之后……
tldr: 该论文提出CAT，一种调用链感知的基于大语言模型的Java项目单元测试生成方法，通过静态分析将调用链、类间依赖、构造函数及第三方依赖等上下文信息融入提示词，并支持迭代式测试修复，从而提升复杂软件系统的测试生成效果。
en_tdlr: CAT is a novel call-chain-aware LLM-based test generation approach for Java projects that explicitly incorporates call-chain and dependency contexts into prompts via dedicated static analysis, with iterative test fixing, to better handle complex inter-class dependencies and deep call chains.
